subtasks.title: Plan Atomic Design Component Hierarchy
subtasks.description: Define and map out the atomic design hierarchy (atoms, molecules, organisms, templates, pages) for the portfolio website, ensuring each component type is clearly identified and categorized.
subtasks.details:
List example components for each atomic level, referencing atomic design principles. Ensure the mapping supports scalability and reusability.
<info added on 2025-08-24T11:06:29.838Z>
# Atomic Design Hierarchy Implementation

## Component Categories
- **Atoms**: Basic building blocks (buttons, inputs, icons, typography)
- **Molecules**: Simple groups of UI elements (search bars, form fields, cards)
- **Organisms**: Complex UI components (navigation bars, contact forms, project showcases)
- **Templates**: Page layouts without specific content
- **Pages**: Specific instances of templates with real content

## Naming Conventions
- Components: PascalCase (Button.tsx, ProjectCard.tsx)
- Utilities: camelCase (formatDate.ts, useLocalStorage.ts)
- Files grouped by atomic level in separate directories
- Index files for clean exports

## Type Definitions
Created TypeScript interfaces and types for:
- Project data
- User preferences
- Theme configuration
- Component props
- API responses

## Utility Functions
- Date formatting helpers
- Local storage management
- Theme switching utilities
- Responsive helpers

## Custom React Hooks
- useTheme: Manages light/dark mode preferences
- useLocalStorage: Persistent state management
- useMediaQuery: Responsive design helper
- useUserPreferences: Stores user settings

## Folder Structure
```
src/
├── components/
│   ├── atoms/
│   ├── molecules/
│   ├── organisms/
│   └── templates/
├── pages/
├── hooks/
├── utils/
├── types/
├── assets/
└── data/
```
</info added on 2025-08-24T11:06:29.838Z>
